flags.reason: The Radio guide (4e470cf) was checked on 1 October 2026 on 0.1.78 (5b6894b); Radio.tsx and all 37 radio tokens are the same on the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02. Read against the installed source and the guide page rendered on it (31 October, headless Chrome, 1280 px), one sentence does not hold, and the entry leaves it out: the States description's “keyboard focus adds a yellow ring and an orange border.” is true only of an unselected Radio. A focused selected Radio keeps its selected look, a deep-purple border rgb(34, 0, 74) and no ring (box-shadow none): the orange border is a fallback for a focused unselected Radio only (Radio.tsx lines 142–147), and radio/focusSelected/boxShadow/size is not in the packaged Coin Variables, so the ring's size is 0 (165, 177, 192). The published Storybook (an older build) draws the same, so this is also a Component Bug: a selected Radio shows no Coin focus indicator. The entry's Focus state rests on the evidence's 0.1.78 sentence for an unselected Radio. Component Bug #548 asks for the focus ring on a selected Radio; once it is fixed the sentence holds, and if it isn't, the guide should say the ring and the orange border show on an unselected Radio. Then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r24, for Marcin to confirm. Component Bug #548.

examples.purpose: Choosing the account to pay from, the guide's In context: a Card holding three ListItem rows, each with a Radio as its trailing part, and a Continue Button. The titles and balances stand for the person's accounts; selected on Salary •• 1180 stands for the account the screen keeps as chosen; each row's onPress and its Radio's onPress stand for the screen choosing that account; Continue stays disabled until one is chosen, so here it is enabled. Each Radio is named by accessibilityLabel with its account, as the Sources note asks.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the radio is selected. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the radio is disabled. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Function to call when the radio is pressed.

props.name: style
props.description: Custom style for the radio container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: On the web accessibilityLabel becomes the Radio's aria-label. Declared: Accessibility label for screen readers / assistive tech.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Accessibility hint for screen readers / assistive tech.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection Radio reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

events.name: onPress
events.description: Function to call when the radio is pressed.
